capability: Derive the canonical active .NET test inventory from compiled discovery instead of manually edited case totals
searchEvidence: CI_DOTNET_SHARDS was the sole canonical project inventory but embedded eight manually maintained total/skip counters.
Local and CI execution already produce compiled test assemblies and exact TRX outcomes through the same scripts/verify.py owner.
VSTest --ListTests expands xUnit Fact and Theory cases from the compiled assembly, while TRX independently records exact test identities and outcomes.

VSTest console discovery truncates long Theory argument displays while TRX retains the full argument text, so parity uses the fully-qualified method identity with multiset multiplicity rather than lossy parameter display text.

Only seven existing platform-conditional cases are owner-approved exclusions: five Windows-processor Bootstrap cases on non-Windows local producers and two Unix-special-file Infrastructure cases on Windows producers; the protected CI workflow is fixed to windows-latest, so its Ubuntu finalizer must require the literal Windows producer identity instead of trusting an arbitrary artifact value or its own host OS.
